Alex (eng-platform): Heads up — Acme (private VPC) asked to manage burst behaviour per-api-key while keeping org-level steady limits. They want a UI in Console to edit a "token_bucket" window and a separate steady qps.
Maya (eng-runtime): Do we want to let customers write raw policy JSON in Private? Security/validation overhead could be big. Prefer structured form in Console + server-side schema validation.
Sam (eng-infra): +1 for structured. Also: we need telemetry hooks so we can show "throttled" vs "rate_limited" counts on Dashboard. Suggest headers: `X-Quota-Remaining`, `X-Quota-Reset`, and `X-Quota-Reason` for debugging.
Katie (product): UX question: if org-level policy conflicts with customer-managed key policy (e.g., org cap lower than key burst), which wins? We should show precedence in UI and block edits that would be no-ops.
Alex (eng-platform): Proposal: precedence = platform (global) -> org -> key. Key can request higher burst only if org allows via an "allow_key_burst" flag. That prevents accidental bypass.
Maya (eng-runtime): Implementation detail: for Private, customers will upload a policy bundle that we merge at runtime. Example local schema (for discussion):
```json
{
  "policy_version": "1",
  "org": {
    "steady_qps": 50,
    "burst_tokens": 200,
    "allow_key_burst": false
  },
  "keys": {
    "key-abc": { "steady_qps": 5, "burst_tokens": 20 },
    "key-def": { "steady_qps": 10 }
  }
}
```
Sam (eng-infra): That looks fine. We should also include a `burst_window_ms` so token refill is explicit. And add validators: max burst <= 10x steady_qps * burst_window_seconds by default.
quota-bot: deploy-check: policy-schema.json validation OK for RFC-2026 branch.
Katie (product): UI suggestions: a bar chart showing current token bucket fullness per key, and a warning when a customer's requested burst exceeds org limits. Also an "explain" tooltip for precedence.
Maya (eng-runtime): For telemetry, add a sampling flag to avoid cardinality blowup for many keys. We can emit aggregated metrics: throttled_count{org,reason}, throttled_count_by_bucket{org,bucket_name}.
Alex (eng-platform): Action items: 1) eng-runtime: add `burst_window_ms` and validators (Maya/Sam) — due EOD Fri. 2) product/design: mock Console panel with precedence UX and explainers (Katie) — due next Tues. 3) infra: add quota response headers and a small dashboard event schema (Sam) — due next Wed.
Sam (eng-infra): I'll add a feature flag for Private deployments so customers can opt-in before we show UI.
Katie (product): I'll capture the flows in a short spec and link to RFC once mocks ready.
Alex (eng-platform): Cool. One more: add tests to ensure fallback works when customer policy is malformed — log + deny edits, not catastrophic.
Maya (eng-runtime): Noted. I'll add schema tests.
quota-bot: note: follow-up thread created in #incidents if any rate-limit regressions post rollout.
Alex (eng-platform): Thanks everyone. I'll create the RFC and attach the sample schema + UX mock once Katie shares.
